static_traits.name: 陈泰乐
static_traits.medical_history: not yet经历类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，能具体描述情绪与事件；存在自我批评与Self-denial倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我在饮食习惯not良和缺乏社交互动方面有困扰，尽管最近在工作上升职，但仍觉得自己是一个“反社会的失败者”。这些感受持续一段时间，但在升职后加剧，导致出现自我批评的想法，进一步自我隔离并怀疑自己的成就，把它们归因为负面特质而非努力。
basic_info.core_demands: Due to negative self-cognition after promotion, seeks help to cope with and improve these problems.

core_beliefs: 我是一个not合群的失败者
我not配获得成功，也not值得被认可

special_situations.event: 升职后面对更高的职责与期待
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完美胜任或立即达到所有要求，就证明我not配、是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更努力工作但negate自身成就，将升职归因于运气或have not其他人可用
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not配被升职，这只是运气好或not人可用

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在公开场合发言必须without懈可击，否则就会被嘲笑，说明我not适合领导
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to speak as little as possible in meetings, repeatedly replays and criticizes herself afterwards, and later avoids speaking in public settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 所有人一定认为我很可笑

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果客户not高兴，一定是我做得很差，且会被投诉
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度道歉、急于弥补以求立刻消除负面反馈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会投诉我，我把事情搞砸了

special_situations.event: Reflection自己的社交状况并自我隔离
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not善社交或not合群，就等同于失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 进一步Reduced socializing、与人保持距离以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我是一个not合群的失败者

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与被接纳，被视为胜任和值得信任的人
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate和嘲笑，担心暴露“not足”而失败
defense_goal: 保持低调与回避以减少被评价的机会
通过过度努力来获得安全感与认可

object_relations.self_representation: not配的“冒牌者”、随时可能失败的人
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者，会嘲笑与negate我的他人

manifestations: 升职后进一步自我隔离
outcomes: 饮食习惯恶化、身心状态下降

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 认为同事“都把我当笑话”
将客户not满直接归因于自己not称职、认为对方会投诉自己

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 在会议中回避发言、把表达收回
避免承担“聚光灯下”的任务
将外向的表达与能量转为内在自我苛责与反刍

想到会被同事或上级评价时
